high_level_description: stc brand style, four Saudi men in a formal exchange, one seated handing over a bank card while three others present stacked books, lit with vivid green and pink duotone lighting.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A room split between deep pink-magenta and teal-green dramatic lighting, with a dark archway and simple white desks.

elements.desc: Three men wearing white thobes, standing in a row each holding a stack of books.
A man wearing a red-and-white checkered ghutra, seated and reaching out to accept a white bank card from the man in front, with books also stacked on the desk before him.
